scope: Current file only; rotated files and other log paths not searched
limitation: Negative correlation only. Zero task-ID matches do not prove successful dispatch, delivery, or filer completion.
command:
ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 -p 222 root@10.84.2.115 'python3 -c '"'"'import datetime,json,os,re
log='"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'/var/log/nasuni/broadcast_network.log'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'
ids=['"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'25463890-e2c3-45f8-81e5-8afa08f9a542'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"', '"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'752185cc-30e4-46d4-8d97-81c218574570'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"', '"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'7e2ce59f-1ed5-42fe-8f8c-7b513ac7a37f'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"', '"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'aa76bada-3b8b-45e5-973d-dac161f4f997'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"', '"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'aaeb3836-38c7-40b5-9c5e-f7659f5b2af1'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"', '"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'ae1e8f89-9c3d-4087-b125-8341a79948a4'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"']
counts={value:0 for value in ids}
first=None
last=None
lines=0
before=os.stat(log)
with open(log,'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'r'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"',encoding='"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'utf-8'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"',errors='"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'replace'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"') as stream:
    for line in stream:
        lines+=1
        timestamp=re.match(r'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}(?:\.\d+)?'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"',line)
        if timestamp:
            first=first or timestamp.group(0)
            last=timestamp.group(0)
        for value in ids:
            if value in line: counts[value]+=1
after=os.stat(log)
print(json.dumps({'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'checked_at_utc'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'log_path'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"':log,'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'lines_examined'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"':lines,'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'first_log_timestamp_as_written'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"':first,'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'last_log_timestamp_as_written'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"':last,'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'per_task_matching_lines'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"':counts,'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'total_task_matches'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"':sum(counts.values()),'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'source_inode_before'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"':before.st_ino,'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'source_inode_after'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"':after.st_ino,'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'source_bytes_before'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"':before.st_size,'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'source_bytes_after'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"':after.st_size,'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'source_changed_during_scan'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"':before.st_ino!=after.st_ino or before.st_size!=after.st_size,'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'read_only'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"':True}))
'"'"''
